subject: Traditional item parameterization for multi-dimensional models

messages.author: bdab35c6890b91af
messages.subject: Traditional item parameterization for multi-dimensional models
parts:
Hello,

I have a one- two-  three-dimensional model and a joint-model, and I want to compare (if different) and describe the difficulty parameters of these models. My question is: is it possible to obtain traditional parameterization for these models? Something similar to the IRT = T command for the summary function for uni-dimensional models. There are no cross-loadings in these models, so this would seem like a reasonable thing to do.

 While I did find the drop.zeros = T for the itemplot function, I can not find any information about how to obtain the numerical values. 

Thanks in advance,
Sverre Ofstad

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Traditional item parameterization for multi-dimensional models
parts:
This seems like a reasonable request. I have added support for computing the classical IRT parameterizations via coef(mod, IRTpars=TRUE) for items that demonstrate simple structure. Feel free to install from the Github dev version to test it out.

Phil
